summary: Publish and resume exact externally selected OMP transcripts without guessing a managed session

replay.detail: Conversation replay uses the exact owner/incarnation transcript binding. A newer native binding supersedes historical import provenance.

schema.detail: No schema or suspension snapshot changes.

rules.detail: Existing subject and incarnation authority remains required. External files must be canonical regular files with the reported native session header. Legacy Linux recovery also fences runtime process ownership and lifetime.

compatibility.detail: External sessionFile reports no longer require a matching file under managed provider-sessions. Suspended sessions recover only their captured incarnation's recorded path; mismatched bindings fail rather than select another conversation. Existing checked path selectors remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: Existing transcripts are unchanged. Failed verification refuses publication or resume without replacing the transcript.
